note_title: 加强收敛性质的条件与手段

callouts.id: 加强收敛性质的条件与手段#1
callouts.title: 借助Borel Cantelli引理来加强收敛性的想法
callouts.body:
如果我们得到$f_n \xrightarrow{\mu} f$，亦或者依照某种范数收敛，然后我们想要根据一个额外的条件$\text{Cond}$去把这个结果加强为几乎处处收敛。我们想到可以借助[[Borel-Cantelli lemma及其应用]]当中其中一个版本的引理(常用引理1)，得到关于$A_{n,\varepsilon}:=\{x:|f_n(x)-f(x)|\geq\varepsilon\}$的级数收敛的信息$$\sum_{n\geq1}\mu(A_{n,\varepsilon})<\infty,\forall \varepsilon>0$$的结论，我们就可以导出$\mu\left(\limsup_{n\to\infty}A_{n,\varepsilon}\right)=0$的结论从而得到几乎处处收敛。因此实现这一点的关键是对$\mu(A_{n,\varepsilon})$做估计。

classification_result.id: 加强收敛性质的条件与手段#1
classification_result.english_title: Using the Borel-Cantelli Lemma to Strengthen Convergence

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Using the Borel-Cantelli Lemma to strengthen convergence
if_strategy_template.summary_en: When one has convergence in measure or convergence in a norm and wants to strengthen it to almost everywhere convergence under an additional condition, a standard approach is to study the sets $A_{n,\varepsilon}:=\{x:|f_n(x)-f(x)|\geq\varepsilon\}$ and prove that $\sum_{n\geq 1}\mu(A_{n,\varepsilon})<\infty$ for every $\varepsilon>0$. Then the Borel-Cantelli lemma implies $\mu(\limsup_{n\to\infty}A_{n,\varepsilon})=0$, yielding almost everywhere convergence.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when the goal is to upgrade convergence in measure or related weaker convergence to almost everywhere convergence, especially when an extra condition allows estimation of $\mu(A_{n,\varepsilon})$, for example via Chebyshev's inequality from norm, variance, expectation, or moment bounds.

callouts.id: 加强收敛性质的条件与手段#2
callouts.title: 利用分段估计来加强收敛性的做法
callouts.body: 如果我们得到$f_n \xrightarrow{\lambda} f$，然后我们想要根据一个额外的条件$\text{Cond}$去把这个结果加强为依某种范数的收敛，例如$L^p$或者一致收敛。我们想到可以按照[[分段估计]]，其中一段利用依测度收敛带来的“集中不等式”来对$A_{n,\varepsilon}:=\{x:|f_n(x)-f(x)|\geq\varepsilon\}$做出$$\lambda(A_{n,\varepsilon})\leq g_n(\varepsilon)$$的估计。然后另外一段则利用额外的条件$\text{Cond}$来做出估计，从而证明某种依照范数的收敛。

classification_result.id: 加强收敛性质的条件与手段#2
classification_result.english_title: Using Piecewise Estimation to Strengthen Convergence

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Using piecewise estimation to strengthen convergence
if_strategy_template.summary_en: When one has convergence in measure and wants to strengthen it to convergence in a norm such as $L^p$ or to uniform convergence, one can split the estimate into parts. One part uses the concentration-type estimate coming from convergence in measure on the sets $A_{n,\varepsilon}:=\{x:|f_n(x)-f(x)|\geq\varepsilon\}$, while the other part uses the additional condition to control the remaining contribution.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when upgrading convergence in measure to stronger norm-based convergence, especially when the problem naturally decomposes into a large-value part controlled by measure estimates and another part controlled by extra assumptions.
